senses.gloss: loop of ribands on the shoe, ankle loop.
units: <cite ref="Niddah 58a:26">Nidd. 58ᵃ</cite> <he>עד מקום ה׳</he> the part of the leg to the place where the loop sits (is called the inside of the leg); <he>וח׳ עצמו</he> and (if blood is found) on the ankle itself. [Oth. opin.: ‘the place where the leg meets the thigh in a squatting position’, Ar.—‘the knee-hole with its sinews’, Rashi.]

senses.gloss: a band with which the saddle or housing of an animal is fastened around its belly; [oth. opin.: the housing itself].
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 19:3">Kel. XIX, 3</cite>. Sifra Sh’mini, Sh’rats., Par. 6, ch. VIII; <cite ref="Shabbat 64a">Sabb. 64ᵃ</cite>.
